registration.roomBox: ShopBuilding.roomBox(type,room,size) hands ShopInterior one room's box + cell grid, so a layout authored in the single-room editor drops into that room of the building unchanged.
registration.grade: z 0 is the pavement for Shopfront; each baked level renders its own floor plane at z 0 and levelZ says where that floor sits in world height.
